worldcombat.skill.fairywind.summary: A spiraling scented breeze is stirred up and sent along the aim: it passes through one foe after another instead of stopping at the first, flinging each one it sweeps to the side. The wide form sweeps wider, pierces more and flings harder but hits lighter and slower; the skimming form is a thinner, sharper, faster line.
worldcombat.skill.fairywind.use.0: Sweep several foes standing in a line
worldcombat.skill.fairywind.use.1: Fling a charging target off your front
worldcombat.skill.fairywind.use.2: Open from range and push a target off cover
Each swept foe takes about %1$s power; the wind pierces up to %2$s more; defence, type matchup and crits are settled on impact.
Range %1$s blocks, the wind travels at %2$s blocks/tick, with a %3$s block swirl cross-section.
A swept foe is flung %1$s blocks along the spin; the gust carries %2$s puffs of fae dust.
Wind-up %1$s s, recovery %2$s s, cooldown %3$s s.
worldcombat.skill.fairywind.wide.on: Wide: cross-section x1.5, pierce +1, fling x1.4, but power x0.85, wind-up +1 tick, cooldown +5 ticks - a wider, looser sweep.
worldcombat.skill.fairywind.wide.off: Skimming: power x1.15, faster throw and shorter cooldown, but a narrow cross-section, less pierce and a weaker fling - a thinner, sharper line.
worldcombat.skill.fairywind.timing: Range %1$s blocks; wind-up %2$s s, recovery %3$s s, costing %4$s PP, cooldown %5$s s.
worldcombat.skill.fairywind.growth.0: From level %1$s the per-hit power rises to %2$s and the pierce cap to %3$s.
worldcombat.skill.fairywind.growth.1: From level %1$s the per-hit power rises to %2$s and the range to %3$s blocks.
worldcombat.skill.fairywind.preference.w: On (wide): cross-section x1.5, pierce +1, fling x1.4, but power x0.85, wind-up +1 tick, cooldown +5 ticks. Off (skimming, default): power x1.15, faster throw and shorter cooldown, but a narrow cross-section, less pierce and a weaker fling.
worldcombat.skill.fairywind.preference.a: Beyond this distance the user closes in first. Larger prefers opening from farther away.
On: with other foes lined up behind the aim, the wind is preferred to run through the line; off: no line counting, ranked as an ordinary ranged attack.
